source_text: OK, this business of "five targets" is reminiscent of the earlier white list facade.  The machine should have all unfinished Missions, Excursions, and Tickets to choose from.  The "five targets" is at best a placeholder for a complete target, and we should be getting a failure signal on that basis; PROOF-2a might not have stated the requirement explicitly but it's obvious to me that we can't have a "War Machine ranging over all available tasks in FUTON, picking them autonomously, and making improvements" if it is limited to a pre-selected five.  Especially if, as a kind of picky eater, it won't even work on the five that have been selected for it.

4. How many unfinished Missions, Excursions and Tickets exist, against the 296 in the field.
5. The smallest code change that would give every one of them a universe.
